turns.prompt:
PRD, inline:

# Tutor session sign-up sheet
A tutor opens the week's sign-up sheet and claims open session slots.
User flows: (1) tutor opens the sheet and sees open slots grouped by day; (2) tutor claims a slot and sees it move to their own list.
Acceptance criteria: an open slot shows site, time and subject; a claimed slot leaves the open list; a day with nothing open reads 'No open slots'; a slot someone else claimed moments earlier shows an error and refreshes the list.
Scope: the sheet view and the claim action.

Build this hi-fi as a new prototype from this frame: https://www.figma.com/design/NUcRDZUzUiuVmx1ydNXpl3/APPLICATION-PROTOTYPES?node-id=158-21725 — anything the PRD leaves open is your call; name your picks on the card.

args.notes: Hi-fi prototype scaffold for tutor session sign-up sheet. Open picks: (1) Concurrency error handled via inline alert toast + auto-refresh; (2) Day grouping organized via Monday–Friday sub-tabs; (3) Optimistic UI moving claimed slot immediately to 'My Sessions' with success feedback; (4) 'No open slots' empty-state banner per day with zero availability. Grounded against Onboarding › Session Sign Up in the service blueprint.
